items.title: Dockerfiles reference non-existent module path
items.description: Both Dockerfiles use app.main:app as the uvicorn entry-point, but neither project has an app/ package. Containers will exit immediately with ModuleNotFoundError — the Docker deployment is entirely broken.
items.fix: Fix each Dockerfile CMD to match the actual module layout. API: use fastapi run main.py --port 8000. Agent: use python main.py or uvicorn main:app.

items.title: web.env uses internal container hostnames in VITE_ vars
items.description: VITE_ env vars are embedded at build time and executed in the user's browser. http://agrisat-api:8000 and http://agrisat-agent:8080 are Docker-internal hostnames unreachable from any browser. All API calls will fail.
items.code:
VITE_API_HOST=http://agrisat-api:8000/api    # ❌ unreachable
VITE_AGENT_HOST=http://agrisat-agent:8080   # ❌ same

# should use the public nginx gateway:
VITE_API_HOST=http://localhost:8000/api
VITE_AGENT_HOST=http://localhost:8000
items.fix: Change web.env to use the nginx public URL. The nginx reverse-proxy already routes /api and /agent paths to the correct services.

items.title: Tool error returns status: true — agent treats failures as success
items.description: When get_environment_stats and get_weather_stats catch an exception, they return {"status": True, "error": "..."}. The agent's system prompt says "check status before using data" — but status is True on failure, so the agent reads a non-existent data key and hallucinates.
items.fix: Return "status": False on every exception path. Add a "data": None key so the agent can safely check both fields.

items.title: Port mismatch across docs, scripts, and env files
items.description: Three sources of truth disagree on the API port: README says 3000, run-all.ps1 starts on 8000, and agrisat-web/.env.example points to localhost:3000. First-time developers get connection refused errors.
items.code:
# docs/index.md:       fastapi dev --port 3000
# run-all.ps1:         --port 8000
# web/.env.example:    VITE_API_HOST=http://localhost:3000/api
items.fix: Align on a single port (3000 per the docs), update run-all.ps1, web/.env.example, and the README to be consistent.

items.title: All DB access is synchronous — blocks the async event loop
items.description: Every FastAPI route uses sqlite3.connect() via Depends(get_db) — a blocking synchronous call inside async handlers. Under concurrent load, each request stalls the event loop. aiosqlite is already in requirements.txt but unused.
items.code:
def get_db():
    connection = sqlite3.connect(settings.dsn, check_same_thread=False)
    yield connection   # ← blocks the event loop
    connection.close()
items.fix: Replace sqlite3 with aiosqlite, make get_db async, and update all repository functions to use await cursor.execute(). Alternatively wrap in asyncio.to_thread() as an interim fix.

items.title: Satellite route: sync httpx, no timeout, no error handling
items.description: The CelesTrak fetch uses synchronous httpx.get() inside an async route (blocks event loop), has no timeout, no raise_for_status(), no rate limiting, and an IndexError if the TLE file length isn't a multiple of 3.
items.code:
async def list_satellites():
    res = httpx.get(CELESTRAK_EARTH_TLE)   # sync! blocks loop
    lines = res.text.splitlines()
    for i in range(0, len(lines), 3):     # IndexError if malformed
        items.append(...)
items.fix: Switch to httpx.AsyncClient with a 10s timeout. Add raise_for_status(), guard range with a modulo check, and add a 5-minute TTL cache.

items.title: CORS wildcard + allow_credentials=True — invalid browser combo
items.description: Browsers reject allow_origins=["*"] with allow_credentials=True per the CORS spec. Credentialed cross-origin requests will silently fail.
items.code:
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,   # invalid with wildcard
)
items.fix: Either drop allow_credentials=True, or replace "*" with an explicit list of allowed frontend origins.

items.title: VARIABLE_KEY_MAP hardcodes database autoincrement IDs
items.description: The frontend maps variable IDs 2–9 to string keys. These are SQLite autoincrement values that break silently if the database is rebuilt. Variable ID 1 has no mapping at all.
items.fix: Fetch the variable list from /api/layers/variables and build the map dynamically at runtime using the id → key fields the API already returns.

items.title: Raster overlay ignores selected date — always shows endTs
items.description: selectedRasterDate state exists and is passed to TimelinePanel, but MapPanel fetches the raster using only timeRange.endTs. Clicking a date dot in the timeline changes state but doesn't change the map overlay.
items.fix: Pass selectedRasterDate as a prop to MapPanel and use it as the raster timestamp, falling back to timeRange.endTs if null.

items.title: Agent tool docstring says str but type hint says int
items.description: ADK generates the tool schema from docstrings. list_zones documents level_id as type str but the Python signature says Optional[int]. The LLM will pass a string, causing type errors downstream.
items.code:
async def list_zones(tool_context, level_id: Optional[int] = None):
    """
    Args:
        level_id (str): The level ID  # ← wrong type
    """
items.fix: Correct the docstring to say level_id (int). Audit all tool docstrings for type mismatches.

items.title: level_id or zone_id truthiness bug in repositories
items.description: Both repos use level_id or zone_id as the SQL parameter. If level_id = 0 (falsy in Python), it falls through to zone_id. Safe only because IDs start at 1.
items.code:
cursor.execute(sql, (level_id or zone_id, ...))
# should be:
cursor.execute(sql, (level_id if zone_id is None else zone_id, ...))
items.fix: Replace all level_id or zone_id with explicit conditional. Add a guard asserting exactly one of the two is provided.

items.title: compare_zones silently truncates metrics with zip()
items.description: The comparison endpoint uses zip(analysis_a.metrics, analysis_b.metrics). If one zone lacks a variable, zip silently truncates without flagging the mismatch.
items.fix: Use a dict-based join on variable key. Return an explicit indicator when a variable is missing from one zone.

items.title: Frontend re-implements backend metric computation with diverging logic
items.description: AnalysisPanel recomputes trend, min, max, and average locally. The backend already returns these in /api/insights/analysis/{zone_id}. Frontend uses index positions while backend uses timestamp deltas — results diverge for irregular time series.
items.fix: Remove frontend metric recomputation. Consume the pre-computed VariableMetricResult objects from the insights API.

items.title: Gemini API key transmitted in base64 header — visible in DevTools
items.description: Every SSE request sends X-Llm-Config: btoa(JSON.stringify({gemini_api_key: ...})). Base64 is not encryption. The key appears in browser DevTools and nginx logs.
items.fix: Move API key management server-side. Store the key in a user session on the agent backend, reference by session token.

items.title: API credentials bundled into frontend JS via VITE_API_ vars
items.description: VITE_API_USERNAME and VITE_API_PASSWORD are embedded in the compiled JS bundle. Any user can extract these from browser source.
items.fix: For internet-facing deployments, proxy API calls through a BFF layer that injects auth server-side. For demo: document the risk clearly.

items.title: getZoneGeoJson calls a non-existent API endpoint
items.description: api.ts has getZoneGeoJson(zoneId) calling GET /layers/zones/{zoneId}/geojson. This route does not exist — the API only has /layers/polygons?level_id=. Any call returns a silent 404.
items.fix: Either add the missing route to the API, or update the frontend to use /layers/polygons with zone filtering.

items.title: Agent raster PNG artifacts silently dropped in chat UI
items.description: get_environment_raster generates a PNG and returns it as an ADK artifact. The chat renderer only processes part.text — images are silently ignored.
items.fix: Add an artifact/inline_data render path in the conversation component. Render base64 PNGs as <img> tags.

items.title: Agent SSE route injection via router mutation is fragile
items.description: The agent main.py overrides ADK's SSE endpoint by inserting a route at app.router.routes[0]. This relies on undocumented ADK internals.
items.fix: Register the custom route under a distinct path like /run_sse_v2 and update the frontend.

items.title: AI mode prefix leaked into user message bubble
items.description: The mode prefix [Mode: compare] is prepended to messages and shown verbatim in the user's chat bubble. The user didn't type it.
items.fix: Separate display text from payload. Show only the user's original text in the bubble; send the prefixed version to the backend only.

items.title: google-adk in agrisat-api requirements — unused large dependency
items.description: The API service has google-adk>=1.33.0 in its requirements but doesn't use it. ADK pulls hundreds of MB of transitive dependencies, inflating image size.
items.fix: Remove google-adk from agrisat-api/requirements.txt. Rebuild the Docker image.

items.title: aiosqlite dependency present but entirely unused
items.description: aiosqlite is in requirements.txt but all database code uses synchronous sqlite3. The dependency is wasted until the async migration is done.
items.fix: Completing the async DB migration (H1) will use this dependency. Until then, add a comment explaining the planned migration.

items.title: Duplicate from typing import in multiple route files
items.description: Several route files have two separate from typing import ... lines. Minor lint noise that should be consolidated.
items.fix: Merge duplicate imports. Consider using ruff or isort as a pre-commit hook.

items.title: Token budget resets on every service restart
items.description: The in-memory _token_usage dict resets on container restart. Users can bypass the budget by restarting the service.
items.fix: Persist token usage in the existing agent SQLite session database. Add a --no-budget flag for local dev.

items.title: No session restore — AI chat history lost on page refresh
items.description: Session ID and message history are held only in React state. Refreshing creates a new session. The server has the history but the frontend never fetches it.
items.fix: Persist sessionId in localStorage. On mount, call the ADK session fetch endpoint to restore history.

items.title: Database files committed to repository
items.description: Two copies of data.db are tracked in git. SQLite files pollute diffs, grow indefinitely, and risk leaking data.
items.fix: Add *.db to .gitignore, run git rm --cached on both files, document the download step.

items.title: Kelvin→Celsius heuristic (temp > 100) is error-prone
items.description: Multiple places use tempRaw > 100 ? tempRaw - 273.15 : tempRaw. If a data error produces a Celsius value above 100, it's wrongly reconverted.
items.fix: Have the API explicitly return Celsius. Remove the conversion heuristic from the frontend.

items.title: Render raster images returned by the AI agent in chat
items.description: The agent can fetch satellite raster images as PNG artifacts, but the frontend only renders text parts. Image responses are invisible to the user — a major missed capability.
items.fix: Add inline_data and artifact rendering to the conversation component. Render base64 PNGs as inline images with a caption.

items.title: Error states surfaced to the user across dashboard data hooks
items.description: When the API is unreachable, data hooks silently fall back to empty arrays. The user sees "No data" with no indication that a network error occurred. isError is never used.
items.fix: Destructure isError from all hooks. Render a clear error banner with a retry button when isError is true.

items.title: Add level_id support to list_environment_time_indices agent tool
items.description: The agent can only query available environmental dates by zone_id, not by level_id. This forces an extra round-trip that increases latency and token usage.
items.fix: Add level_id: Optional[int] parameter to the tool, mirroring the API's capability. Update the docstring.

items.title: Keyboard navigation for map zone selection (Accessibility)
items.description: Zones can only be selected by clicking on the map. There is no keyboard path to cycle through zones — fails WCAG 2.1 criterion 2.1.1.
items.fix: Add a zone list combobox that lists all zones for the selected level. Selecting from the list fires the same handler as a map click.

items.title: API pagination for list endpoints
items.description: All list endpoints return the entire dataset. As the analysis area expands, zone and time-series payloads will grow significantly with no pagination.
items.fix: Add limit/offset query params. Return a {items, total, offset} wrapper. Implement cursor-based pagination for time series.

items.title: Persist timeline expand/collapse state across navigation
items.description: The TimelinePanel collapsed/expanded state resets on unmount. Repeat users must re-expand it every time.
items.fix: Store the boolean in localStorage or the Zustand settings store and read it on mount.

items.title: Loading indicator in AnalysisPanel when switching zones
items.description: When switching zones, keepPreviousData shows stale data with no visual cue that the panel is refreshing.
items.fix: Destructure isFetching from React Query. Show a subtle loading overlay when isFetching && !isLoading.

items.title: Add TLS termination to nginx for internet-facing deployments
items.description: The current nginx setup is HTTP-only. All credentials, API keys, and data travel unencrypted. For non-loopback deployments, TLS is required.
items.fix: Replace bare nginx with a Caddy sidecar (auto ACME/Let's Encrypt) or add a Certbot init container. Add HSTS and HTTP→HTTPS redirect.

items.title: Replace unsafe-inline CSP with nonce-based script allowlist
items.description: The nginx CSP allows script-src 'unsafe-inline' which negates most XSS protection. It exists to support the theme-init inline script.
items.fix: Extract the inline script into a separate .js file, or compute a SHA-256 hash and replace unsafe-inline with 'sha256-'.

items.title: Optimize MapPanel — avoid full layer rebuild on zone change
items.description: updateMapLayers removes and re-adds all MapLibre layers on every state change. Zone selection — a common action — triggers a full rebuild instead of a simple paint update.
items.fix: For zone selection, call map.setPaintProperty() instead of removing/re-adding layers. Reserve full rebuild for structural changes.

items.title: Virtualize timeline date buttons for large weather datasets
items.description: The condensed timeline renders a <button> per timestamp. With 3-hourly weather × 90 days = 720 DOM nodes with no virtualization.
items.fix: Group timestamps into day buckets with a popover, or use virtual scroll for the expanded view.

items.title: Enable SQLite WAL mode and set connection timeout
items.description: Without WAL mode, SQLite uses a global write lock causing "database is locked" under concurrent access. No timeout means indefinite hangs.
items.fix: After opening each connection: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000.

items.title: Token budget exhaustion — add clickable link to settings panel
items.description: When the token budget is exhausted, the error message references "Settings → LLM Connection" but has no clickable link or button.
items.fix: Add a button in the error message that triggers the settings dialog programmatically via the Zustand store.
